1.shakir: I swear by the early hours of the day,

2.sahih_international: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
2.pickthall: And by the night when it is stillest,
2.yusuf_ali: And by the Night when it is still,-
2.shakir: And the night when it covers with darkness.
2.muhammad_sarwar: and by the calm of night,
2.mohsin_khan: And by the night when it is still (or darkens);

3.sahih_international: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
3.pickthall: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee,
3.yusuf_ali: Thy Guardian-Lord hath not forsaken thee, nor is He displeased.
3.shakir: Your Lord has not forsaken you, nor has He become displeased,
3.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), your Lord has not abandoned you (by not sending you His revelation), nor is He displeased with you.
3.mohsin_khan: Your Lord (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) has neither forsaken you nor hated you.
3.arberry: Thy Lord has neither forsaken thee nor hates thee

4.sahih_international: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
4.pickthall: And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former,
4.yusuf_ali: And verily the Hereafter will be better for thee than the present.
4.shakir: And surely what comes after is better for you than that which has gone before.
4.muhammad_sarwar: The reward in the next life will certainly be better for you than worldly gains.
4.mohsin_khan: And indeed the Hereafter is better for you than the present (life of this world).
4.arberry: and the Last shall be better for thee than the First.

5.sahih_international: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
5.pickthall: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content.
5.yusuf_ali: And soon will thy Guardian-Lord give thee (that wherewith) thou shalt be well-pleased.
5.shakir: And soon will your Lord give you so that you shall be well pleased.
5.muhammad_sarwar: Your Lord will soon grant you sufficient favors to please you.
5.mohsin_khan: And verily, your Lord will give you (all i.e. good) so that you shall be well-pleased.
5.arberry: Thy Lord shall give thee, and thou shalt be satisfied.

6.sahih_international: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
6.pickthall: Did He not find thee an orphan and protect (thee)?
6.yusuf_ali: Did He not find thee an orphan and give thee shelter (and care)?
6.shakir: Did He not find you an orphan and give you shelter?
6.muhammad_sarwar: Did He not find you as an orphan and give you shelter?
6.mohsin_khan: Did He not find you (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) an orphan and gave you a refuge?
6.arberry: Did He not find thee an orphan, and shelter thee?

7.sahih_international: And He found you lost and guided [you],
7.pickthall: Did He not find thee wandering and direct (thee)?
7.yusuf_ali: And He found thee wandering, and He gave thee guidance.
7.shakir: And find you lost (that is, unrecognized by men) and guide (them to you)?
7.muhammad_sarwar: Did He not find you wandering about and give you guidance?
7.mohsin_khan: And He found you unaware (of the Quran, its legal laws, and Prophethood, etc.) and guided you?
7.arberry: Did He not find thee erring, and guide thee?

8.sahih_international: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
8.pickthall: Did He not find thee destitute and enrich (thee)?
8.yusuf_ali: And He found thee in need, and made thee independent.
8.shakir: And find you in want and make you to be free from want?
8.muhammad_sarwar: And did He not find you in need and make you rich?
8.mohsin_khan: And He found you poor, and made you rich (selfsufficient with selfcontentment, etc.)?
8.arberry: Did He not find thee needy, and suffice thee?

9.sahih_international: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
9.yusuf_ali: Therefore, treat not the orphan with harshness,
9.shakir: Therefore, as for the orphan, do not oppress (him).
9.mohsin_khan: Therefore, treat not the orphan with oppression,
9.arberry: As for the orphan, do not oppress him,

10.sahih_international: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
10.pickthall: Therefor the beggar drive not away,
10.shakir: And as for him who asks, do not chide (him),
10.muhammad_sarwar: and do not reject the beggars
10.arberry: and as for the beggar, scold him not;

11.sahih_international: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
11.pickthall: Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse.
11.yusuf_ali: But the bounty of the Lord - rehearse and proclaim!
11.shakir: And as for the favor of your Lord, do announce (it).
11.muhammad_sarwar: and proclaim the bounties of your Lord.
11.mohsin_khan: And proclaim the Grace of your Lord (i.e. the Prophethood and all other Graces).
11.arberry: and as for thy Lord's blessing, declare it.
